[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 28[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

With the holiday season just around the corner, we want to wish everyone a very happy holiday season from everyone within the Hack Forums News Team this year, and we hope everyone has a great time with their loved ones. What a crazy year it has been, and we can't wait for the new year. 

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6316153][color=#ffffff]Marketplace Sort Order[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Recently there has been a discussion about the marketplace here on the site. [mention=1] has changed how the threads within the marketplace section work back to how they were many years ago. The change has been put in place as of the 19th of December and is currently in a phase for testing to see how members of the site treat the change. Feel free to share your thoughts on this policy change.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6314337][color=#ffffff]The Hack Forums Wiki Returns[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=2331053]

The Hack Forums Wiki has returned. The site has been under some work recently as the site was sadly left with a load of issues and no one was running the official site. Thanks to everyone within the HF news team, the site is now under new leadership and, thanks to [mention=1] allowing the team to start their work on this while maintaining the HF news, the site is back getting some lovely changes and getting updated daily to bring it back to a new modern day Wikipedia with a load of information for everyone to read up on.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6299866][color=#ffffff]Hack Forums News Team - Become a Writer[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=2331053]

Are you looking to join the HF news team? Do you enjoy making threads or even want to become a better writer? Well, we are looking for members of the site to help write each week and are looking for anyone who has any interest. We have a few new sections opening up right now, and we would love for you to see if they would be anything of interest to you. If you are interested, please check out the thread or contact [mention=2331053] to discuss joining the team behind the HF News.

This week we have our Christmas season of music. For the next few editions we will be featuring a few Christmas songs. We wanted to feature more than one song each week but, sadly, we have found, due to the limitations of the site, we are only allowed to feature one song, so we will make sure they are only the best. If you would like to nominate your own, please head over to this thread here. [url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6314321]>>Click Here<<[/url]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6314498]👉🏼 250,000 Bytes Contest - $600 Value 💸💸💸[/url] By [mention=5418830] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

[mention=5418830] is hosting a massive bytes contest for Christmas this year. The Bytes Millionaire themselves has this contest open for upgraded site members, and it will be ending on the 25th of December 2025. Right in time for Christmas this year. Make sure you get your entry.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6315782]$100 BTC Community Contest | 30 Days | Upgraded Members[/url] By [mention=5711781] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

The user known as [mention=5711781] is giving everyone the chance to win $100 BTC. Everyone who enters has the chance to get a bonus entry into the giveaway as well, which is noted all within the thread. The giveaway ends on the 13th of January 2026. Good luck to everyone who enters.

[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Russian General Killed in Moscow Car Bomb[/color][/size][/b][/u]

A car bomb exploded in Moscow, killing a Russian general marking a third high-profile assassination of a senior officer in just over a year.

[b][url=https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/car-bomb-kills-russian-general-in-moscow]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]US Diplomatic Shake Up[/color][/size][/b][/u]

The US State Department has abruptly recalled over two dozen career ambassadors, a controversial move that critics say weakens US diplomatic engagement abroad.

[b][url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2025/12/22/trump-ambassadors-recalled/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Thai Cambodian Border Clashes[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Fresh fighting erupted along the Thai Cambodian border just as ASEAN foreign ministers convened in Malaysia to pursue peace and de-escalation.

[b][url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/22/fresh-clashes-erupt-on-thai-cambodia-border-as-asean-convenes-peace]Source[/url][/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/tech-brown.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer - [/b][/size]  [mention=5465469]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]AI stocks today show Nvidia memory boom and cloud deals lifting sector[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
Market reports say Nvidia’s chips and Micron’s AI memory sales are boosting tech hardware stocks as cloud service contracts and infrastructure spending expand rapidly.  
[b][url=https://ts2.tech/en/ai-stocks-today-dec-19-2025-117-p-m-et-nvidias-china-chip-review-microns-ai-memory-boom-and-big-cloud-deals-lift-the-sector]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Google teams with Meta to boost PyTorch TPU support as Nvidia alternative[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
Google and Meta are collaborating to improve PyTorch framework compatibility with Tensor Processing Unit hardware, offering developers an alternative to Nvidia GPU-centric AI workflows.  
[b][url=https://www.thehansindia.com/technology/tech-news/googles-torch-tpu-project-aims-to-loosen-nvidias-hold-on-ai-hardware-1032346]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]LG unveils new RGB LED TV panel with advanced display and chipset features[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
LG announced its MRGB95B RGB LED television tech with enhanced color accuracy and next-gen display hardware, part of a 2026 lineup pushing premium immersive viewing.  
[b][url=https://www.wired.com/story/gear-news-of-the-week-lg-debuts-an-rgb-led-tv-and-google-brings-find-hub-to-wear-os]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Nvidia-led NitroGen AI plays video games and signals hardware innovation[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
A new Nvidia-related research project called NitroGen demonstrates a generalist AI that can autonomously play many video games, showing potential future hardware integration for gaming and robotics.  
[b][url=https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/artificial-intelligence/nvidia-led-nitrogen-is-a-generalist-video-gaming-ai-that-can-play-any-title-research-also-has-big-implications-for-robotics]Source[/url][/b]
[/align]
